item.title: Canadá y la UE buscarán la alianza más estrecha posible sin llegar a la adhesión

item.title: 'Five churches set on fire by Muslims?' Fake news by Islamophobic social media accounts
item.description: Several social media accounts associated with sharing anti-immigrant views claim French Muslims were responsible for burning five churches on October 17 – the day the nation was rocked by en masse protests. item.title: New York appeals court blocks tenants' $321,728 mould damage claim over delays and missing proof
item.description: Recently, a New York appeals court dismissed further claims from tenants regarding property damage in their ongoing case. The court determined that the tenants significantly postponed presenting evidence for their $321,728.79 claim linked to health problems from mould exposure, which initially surfaced in 2018. Adding such claims post-discovery was seen as prejudicial to the landlord, but the case will continue with original personal injury allegations. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
